verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party licensing, pricing, or edition documentation that says whether commercial or enterprise use needs a paid license. The only related item is a community comment that the CLI is MIT-licensed while the MetalRT engine is commercial. That is third-party commentary, not product documentation of license terms. Cloud usage tracking and account-free local use are adjacent features, not licensing clarity.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
